import modlix
pages = modlix.pages.list(app_code='vclone')
existing = [p for p in pages if p.get('name') == 'home']
if existing:
    cur = modlix.pages.get('home', app_code='vclone')
    print(f"page exists, version {cur.get('version')}, components={len(cur.get('componentDefinition') or {})}")
    # Print a summary of the component tree
    cd = cur.get('componentDefinition', {})
    print(f"Root keys: {list(cd.keys())[:10]}")
else:
    print("page does not exist yet")
    
print(f"\nAll pages in vclone: {[p.get('name') for p in pages]}")
